# QoF v1.6.0's "Unleashed" Update

> [!NOTE]
> A Minecraft Bedrock addon that adds small vanilla-friendly features. Each module is configurable through the in-game pack settings panel.

## Changelog

- ${\color{#fff000}\textsf{QoF}}$ no longer blocks Achievement Progression. You can now install ${\color{#fff000}\textsf{QoF}}$ in a normal survival world and earn achievements alongside your friends.
- Migrated to `@stable` APIs, moving away from experimental dependencies.
- Updated solid block detection to work correctly under the stable API.
- The wiki has been refreshed with the latest changes. Explore it at [qof.aitji.xyz](https://qof.aitji.xyz).
- Removed the beta API checker from mcfunction.
- Removed the Minecraft addon version display from `/info` and `/qof:info`.

### Offhand

- The offhand visual helper now responds with instant sounds and particles instead of on-screen notification messages, keeping things snappier and less intrusive.
- Items with `lock mode` set will no longer be moved into the offhand slot.

# Pre-release Changelogs (v1.5.x)

All updates from pre-releases are included in the v1.6.0 release.


<details>
  <summary><strong>v1.5.1 <a href="https://github.com/aitji/QoF/releases/tag/v1.5.1">Take me there</a></strong></summary>

## 1.5.1

* all major updates are now named
* some frequently used player data is now cached: "name", "platform type", "gamemode", and "permission level"  
* permission level is no longer ignored, players now need at least "member" permission to interact with QoF  
* new command: "/info"  
  * shows the current QoF version
  * shows which modules are enabled
  * useful for bug reports
* removed some settings considered "too advanced"
      
> if you still want to edit removed configs, check "~/behaviors\_pack/QoF/scripts/\_config.js"
> guide: https://github.com/aitji/QoF/blob/behavior\_packs/src/\_config.ts

### License Change

- Changed the software license from MIT License to the QoF Noncommercial License 1.0.
- Existing versions remain under their previously published license terms.
- Future releases are licensed under the QoF Noncommercial License 1.0.
      
### Bartering Bat

this module is managed by [@pickerth\_12](https://github.com/pickerth_12) and cannot be disabled because it does not live in scripts

* hold a "glow berry" to lure a bat
* feed a bat with a "glow berry" to trade
* 2 minute cooldown per trade

### Offhand

* micro optimization to item checking logic

</details>
